# Warlock AI Anthropic

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-anthropic`

> Anthropic SDK adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [ai-anthropic](@warlock.js/ai-anthropic/skills/SKILL.md): Anthropic Claude adapter for Warlock AI: `AnthropicSDK`, `AnthropicModel`, `AnthropicCallOptions` and `ANTHROPIC_MODEL_PRICING`. Use for "connect Claude", streaming, tools, thinking, caching, native search or context management through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents and custom tools; @warlock.js/ai-bedrock for Claude on AWS; @warlock.js/ai-cli for terminal agents.
